subregion.name: Edge of Reality, north-central
subregion.summary: A linear corridor connecting the northern and central chambers.

room.title: giant bulb clearing
room.body: Dark void dirt tangled with briars next to a massive bulbous plant.

room.title: cobble rubble street
room.body: A stretch of cobblestone ground littered with brick rubble and debris.

room.title: iron gate stretch
room.body: A cobblestone path running past an iron gate arch and grotesque flesh growths.

room.title: blood pool clearing
room.body: Dark void dirt beside a pool of red liquid, fringed with tangled brambles and twisted roots.

room.title: void chasm trail
room.body: A dry dirt and gravel trail running along the edge of a red void, marked with dead pine trunks.

room.title: overturned carriage stretch
room.body: Rubble and angular cobblestones along the street, beside an overturned carriage.

room.title: rutted stone road
room.body: A cobblestone road with deep wagon ruts, flanked by ruined timber buildings and mounds of flesh.

room.title: void cannon redoubt
room.body: A patch of dirt bordered by the red void, with a wheeled cannon beside spiked wooden barricades.

room.title: barricaded street
room.body: Cobblestones strewn with rubble, flanked by heaps of corpses beside a timber fence.

room.title: cobbled street stretch
room.body: Angular cobblestones and brick rubble cover the street beside a raised stone sidewalk.

room.title: void crystal clearing
room.body: Ashen rock and bone piles around a glowing red crystal set between black stone spires.

room.title: overturned wagon street
room.body: A rubble-strewn cobblestone street beside an overturned wagon and a lit street lamp.

room.title: blood pool hollow
room.body: Cobblestones and dark dirt bordered by twisted trees and a pool of blood.

room.title: gnarled root clearing
room.body: Dark void dirt ground beside massive gnarled tree roots and boulders.

room.title: carriage sidewalk
room.body: A brick sidewalk and cobblestone street beside a streetlamp and a parked carriage.

room.title: charred bone ridge
room.body: A charred rock ridge lined with large bone ribcages and thorny brush above the red void.

room.title: bone strewn flagstones
room.body: Stone flagstones strewn with bone piles along a masonry wall.

room.title: catacomb bone hall
room.body: A stone-cobbled crypt floor with heaps of bones against the walls and small urns set into stone niches.

room.title: red river crossing
room.body: A dark dirt path crossed by a red river, bordered by bare twisted trees.

room.title: stone arch clearing
room.body: Dirt and cobblestones between an autumn tree and a ruined stone arch.

room.title: gnarled dirt clearing
room.body: Dry dirt and gravel ground bordered by gnarled black trees and the red void.

room.title: rubble path
room.body: Cobblestone ground covered in broken stone and wood rubble.

room.title: gnarled tree clearing
room.body: Dry dirt and gravel at the base of a massive gnarled tree trunk, surrounded by tangled roots and red haze.

room.title: plank bridge foot
room.body: Rubble ground at the base of a wooden plank bridge, beside a massive flesh growth.

room.title: charred bone junction
room.body: A dark path of charred rock and bone piles, flanked by jagged ribcages and tentacles along the void chasm.

room.title: arched gate landing
room.body: Flagstone paving before a high stone archway, flanked by two braziers with blue flames.

room.title: charred rock path
room.body: A narrow path of charred rock flanked by jagged obsidian spires beside a ruined stone wall.

room.title: void dirt shelf
room.body: Dark earth surrounded by a deep red void, bordered by jagged rock and twisted dead roots.

room.title: blood pool shore
room.body: Dark void dirt and bare dead trees along the edge of a deep red pool.

room.title: ruined gate passage
room.body: Stone steps through a breached masonry wall, with an iron gate and rubble underfoot.

room.title: jagged void path
room.body: A narrow path of charred rock between towering obsidian spikes, glowing with red rift energy.

room.title: sigil pillars
room.body: Ashen ground strewn with bone piles and glowing red cracks, flanked by obsidian rocks carved with red runes.

room.title: prison gate bridge
room.body: A wooden plank bridge crossing to an arched stone gate marked Burrwitch Prison.

room.title: broken timber floor
room.body: A floor of rubble and broken timber planks beside ruined stone walls.

room.title: charred ash clearing
room.body: A clearing of charred rock and ash, with piles of bones and wooden stakes along the edges.

room.title: twisted tree hollow
room.body: Dry dirt ground set among tangled, bare trees.

room.title: gibbet post
room.body: A stony dirt road with green cracks, beside a tall wooden gibbet and a hanging iron cage.

room.title: glowing pool chamber
room.body: A stone catacomb floor around a glowing circular pool, surrounded by piles of skulls and bones.

room.title: gnarled root clearing 2
room.body: Dark dirt and dried needles under reaching branches and gnarled trees.

room.title: spiked branch path
room.body: A narrow branch path over the red void, flanked by spiked barricades and giant bone ribcages.

room.title: catacomb chamber
room.body: Cobblestone floor in a stone catacomb, with bone piles against the wall and urns in wall niches.

room.title: spiked barricade path
room.body: A narrow dirt path between spiked wooden palisades, suspended over the red abyss.

room.title: tentacle walkway
room.body: A ruined stone walkway with iron railings, arched over by a large fleshy tentacle.

room.title: charred void ledge

room.title: spiked timber clearing
room.body: A patch of red ground surrounded by jagged timber barricades and bare tree trunks.

room.title: bone pile ledge

room.title: charred bone yard

room.title: fleshy stone walkway

room.title: skull pile path
room.body: Dark ashen rock beside a large mound of skulls and scattered bones.

room.title: ruined carpet path
room.body: Rubble and ruined flagstones strewn with a red carpet, bordered by flesh growths and stone wall remnants.

room.title: pale stump red pool
room.body: A shallow red pool around a pale dead tree trunk, beneath a jagged wooden fence.

room.title: ruined timber cell
room.body: Brick rubble and broken timber frames fill a ruined stone room with barred windows.

room.title: skull wall hollow
room.body: Charred rock ground beside a dense wall of skulls and bone heaps.

room.title: aether cracked cobbles
room.body: Cobblestone ground split by glowing green aether cracks, bordered by broken wooden fencing and stone rubble.

room.title: flesh tendril path
room.body: A stone tile walkway flanked by grotesque flesh masses and a rising tentacle.

room.title: red pool dead trees
room.body: A shallow pool of red liquid among tangled black roots and bare dead trees.

room.title: charred void rim
room.body: Charred dirt and ash along the edge of a red abyss, with scattered bone piles.

room.title: black spire ledge
room.body: Charred ashen rock on a cliff beside jagged black spires over a red void.

room.title: flesh maw walkway
room.body: Brick pavement behind a wooden barrier, beside a tooth-lined flesh pit.

room.title: scaffolded stone walkway
room.body: Rubbled brick paving along a stone wall, bordered by wooden scaffolding and iron bar fences.

room.title: twisted root ledge
room.body: A dirt path along a rock ledge, shadowed by massive tangled tree roots over the red abyss.

room.title: iron gate terrace
room.body: A stone brick platform with a wooden bench, bordered by an iron gate and fleshy growths.

room.title: aether crystal walkway
room.body: A wooden plank walkway alongside iron bars, with glowing green aether crystals pushing up through the boards.

room.title: ruined upper floor
room.body: A broken plank floor inside a ruined house with exposed timber beams and shattered walls.

room.title: crimson void hollow
room.body: Red void ground surrounded by massive twisted roots and thorny black branches.

room.title: briar tangle
room.body: Muddy ground enclosed by thick tangled briars and sharp thorn branches.

room.title: thorny bramble path
room.body: A dark dirt path winding through thick brambles and tangled thorns over the red abyss.

room.title: ruined shack floor
room.body: Plank floorboards inside a broken wooden shack with an overturned worktable.

room.title: blood pool bank
room.body: Dark dirt along the edge of the red lake, with bare dead trees and boulders.

room.title: locomotive clearing
room.body: A dirt clearing beside a dark steam locomotive, bordered by twisted bare trees and wooden fences.

room.title: crater clearing
room.body: Dry dirt ground marked by a wide shallow crater, bordered by dead tree stumps and jagged black rock.

room.title: spiked barricade bend
room.body: Dry dirt ground beside a spiked wooden barricade and dead trees.
